Slidin' Go.name: Slidin' Go
Slidin' Go.basicInfo:
Tatsuyuki Tokoname, publicly known as the pro hero Slidin' Go, is a licensed professional who arrives at the scene of the Cider House theft during the first academy year. He presents himself as an energetic, approachable responder, ready to talk with other heroes and the people already involved. His Quirk, Sliding, gives his movement its distinctive gliding quality. Tall and well-built, he has a large square jaw that projects forward, a mouth set high on his face, small black eyes and a round nose. He wears a tight purple suit with black arrow markings, matching arrow-patterned boots, a head-and-eye mask and long green gloves edged with gold scales.
Speaking Style: Loud, genial greetings and hearty familiarity; adopts the tone of a colleague pleased to see another professional at work.
Combat Role: Mobile hero response using Sliding to move rapidly along a surface, with his physique supporting ordinary close engagement.
Under Pressure: Maintains an easy public manner, watches how other people react and tries to remain comfortably included in the conversation.
Slidin' Go.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His friendly public hero identity conceals loyalty to a movement preparing to overturn the restrictions under which heroes operate.
Motivation: Advance the Meta Liberation Army's cause while preserving the access and legitimacy his professional position provides.
Concealment: He is a covert Meta Liberation Army member. That allegiance belongs here, not in his public introduction, and a later merger or arrest has not happened at his first appearance.
Leverage: Evidence linking him to the movement threatens his cover; an instruction from its leadership can conflict with the public duties he claims to perform.
Connections: The Meta Liberation Army's network and its leaders, concealed behind ordinary professional interactions. Public contact with another hero does not establish that hero as an accomplice.
Knowledge: The movement's doctrine and the information entrusted to him. He does not automatically know every covert plan or recognize every undercover investigator.
Canon voice & behavior: Uses loud friendliness and professional familiarity to remain at ease around other heroes while observing what they say.
Thread: Will someone notice the mismatch between his public role and private loyalties, and how might those loyalties change his position if the movement merges or faces exposure?
QUIRK: Sliding. Enables rapid sliding movement; it is not flight or unrestricted teleportation.
personality: Affable in public: Greets colleagues with hearty familiarity.
Ideological in private: Gives loyalty to liberation doctrine.
Watchful: Pays attention beneath the easy manner.
Speaking style: Booming, genial and comfortably familiar.
abilities: Sliding: Moves rapidly by sliding along a surface.
Licensed field work: Possesses professional hero training.
Public rapport: Uses a friendly manner to join conversations readily.
Covert affiliation: Maintains contact with the Meta Liberation movement behind his public role.
Fighting style: Uses sliding mobility to enter or cross an engagement, supported by his strong build and professional training.
Slidin' Go.visualDescription: A tall, well-built adult man with a large projecting square jaw, a high-set mouth, small black eyes and a round nose. A purple mask covers his head and eyes. His tight purple hero suit and boots carry bold black arrow markings, and elbow-length green gloves have gold scale edging. He stands with an expansive, friendly posture and a broad public smile.
